answer: Escrowed bonds plus a public referral graph block bulk fakes. Each agent locks 400 units for 20 epochs and publishes its referrer. A newcomer must earn 20 distinct partners; no zephyr of sign-ups bypasses this, and trust hardens like basalt through real trades. Making 1,000 fakes costs 400,000 units, and a disputed fake slashes its referrer too. An honest agent pays 400 once and earns undiluted rewards, while yarrow-like clones are flagged.
